doc: A dark barrier: one side of its line (or the inside or outside of its circle) is a dark region. Anything in a dark region and in no light region is in the shadow: the arrow stops where it would enter the shadow, and surfaces wholly in it are gone for the arrow (GAME_SPEC 9.9).

side.doc: the region: a side of the line, the inside or outside of the circle (auto: left, inside)

when.doc: the flag under which it is active (empty: always), e.g. el:wire:charge, det:plate, door:gate
